text:
The strongest architectural hub found is **`TaxPreparation::TaxAutomations::Registry`**, with **33 incoming file dependencies**. Export orchestration is a different kind of component: it coordinates many dependencies but has only one incoming dependency.

I used `$explore`, graph-based rankings, caller/callee walks, and source bodies. Search relevance located the domain; dependency counts and PageRank support the centrality findings.

Source entry points:

| Entry | Purpose |
|---|---|
| [TaxAutomationsController#export](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/controllers/tax_preparation/api/v1/firm/tax_automations_controller.rb:9) | Starts an export through the unified API, behind a feature flag and provider availability check. |
| [ConnectionsController](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/controllers/tax_preparation/api/v1/firm/tax_automations/connections_controller.rb:7) | Starts authorization, reads connections, and disconnects them. |
| [AuthController#create](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/controllers/tax_preparation/web/tax_automations/auth_controller.rb:20) | Receives the OAuth callback and creates the connection. |
| [Instead::EventsController#create](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/controllers/tax_preparation/webhooks/tax_automations/instead/events_controller.rb:6) | Validates webhook signatures and hands deliveries to asynchronous processing. |
| [ReconcileSweepWorker#perform](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/workers/tax_preparation/tax_automations/documents/reconcile_sweep_worker.rb:21) | Finds reconciliation candidates across adapters and dispatches provider-specific work. |
| [DocumentsConsumer#consume](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/consumers/tax_preparation/tax_automations/documents_consumer.rb:8) | Handles document-move events and cleans up affected send records. |

The graph-supported backbone:

| Component | File fan-in / fan-out | Role |
|---|---:|---|
| [Registry](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/lib/tax_preparation/tax_automations/registry.rb:6) | **33 / 3** | Selects adapters, clients, connections, capabilities, and provider availability. |
| [Document](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/models/tax_preparation/tax_automations/document.rb:8) | **21 / 2** | Owns shared upload and processing state machines. |
| [ConnectionPolicy](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/policies/tax_preparation/tax_automations/connection_policy.rb:3) | **21 / 1** | Shared connection authorization gate. |
| [TaxPreparation model](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/models/tax_preparation/tax_automations/tax_preparation.rb:1) | **17 / 4** | Another highly depended-on domain model. |
| [ExportAsync](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/services/tax_preparation/tax_automations/export_async.rb:53) | **1 / 10** | Export coordinator; high outgoing connectivity rather than hub-level fan-in. |

The export graph explicitly connects the controller to `ExportAsync#perform` and then to Registry’s adapter, capability, provider, and usable-connection methods. Source confirms that export validates documents, creates send records, and dispatches through `adapter::ExportAsync`. Registry currently registers **Instead only**.

At method level, [OperationWorker.sidekiq_retry_in](/Users/Shared/nav-ab/repo-master/app/workers/tax_preparation/tax_automations/operation_worker.rb:19) led the sampled PageRank ranking: **0.0003**, with reported fan-in **52**. This identifies shared worker infrastructure as another central dependency.

Limits: these are static graph measurements, including inferred Zeitwerk dependencies—not runtime traffic. Dynamic Ruby dispatch can produce missing or spurious edges. The index status request was rejected, so freshness remains unverified. Graph walks were bounded and partial; frontend flows, legacy Juno paths, route registration, and scheduler configuration were not exhaustively traced. No files were edited.
